results.mutation: 将二维网格误作平面前缀

procedure_source:
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,unittest,io
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();rules=root/'scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py';recipes=root/'scripts/gmyhf_statement_fixes.py';pipe=root/'scripts/repair_gmyhf_sample_findings.py'
originals={p:p.read_text() for p in (rules,recipes,pipe)}
cases=[
(rules,'放过等于250的尺寸','if m < 250 and n < 250:','if m <= 250 and n <= 250:','test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_grid_and_digit_repairs_preserve_unaffected_values'),
(rules,'错误裁去首列','row[:width]','row[-width:]','test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_grid_and_digit_repairs_preserve_unaffected_values'),
(rules,'将二维网格误作平面前缀','values[2+i*n:2+(i+1)*n]','values[2+i*249:2+(i+1)*249]','test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_grid_and_digit_repairs_preserve_unaffected_values'),
(rules,'仍保留零查询',"return f'{left} {right} 1\\n'.encode()","return f'{left} {right} 0\\n'.encode()",'test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_grid_and_digit_repairs_preserve_unaffected_values'),
(rules,'意外修改查询区间',"return f'{left} {right} 1\\n'.encode()","return f'{left+1} {right} 1\\n'.encode()",'test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_grid_and_digit_repairs_preserve_unaffected_values'),
(recipes,'目标列仍越界',"replace('(m,n)','(m-1,n-1)')","replace('(m,n)','(m-1,n)')",'test_gmyhf_statement_fixes.StatementFixTests.test_goal_and_digit_output_use_the_defined_variables'),
(recipes,'输出仍固定数字2',"replace('数字 2','数字 a')","replace('数字 2','数字 2')",'test_gmyhf_statement_fixes.StatementFixTests.test_goal_and_digit_output_use_the_defined_variables'),
(recipes,'样例混入标签与答案','result.append(match[1].strip())','result.append(match[0].strip())','test_gmyhf_statement_fixes.StatementFixTests.test_embedded_grid_and_digit_samples_are_not_mixed_with_answers'),
(pipe,'未绑定第9批数据回执',"else 'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch9.json'","else 'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch7.json'",'test_gmyhf_statement_fixes.FollowupWriterTests.test_ninth_batch_binds_repaired_files_for_both_statement_changes')]
results=[]
try:
 for p,name,old,new,test in cases:
  assert originals[p].count(old)==1,(name,originals[p].count(old));p.write_text(originals[p].replace(old,new))
  run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest','tests.'+test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
  assert run.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode});p.write_text(originals[p])
finally:
 for p,s in originals.items():p.write_text(s)
sys.path.insert(0,str(root));from tests.test_gmyhf_review_fixes import ReviewRulesTests
from unittest.mock import patch
for n,fn,old,new,test in [(28277,'arrows','int(a[u] != direction)','int(a[u] == direction)','test_arrows_reference_against_heap_shortest_paths'),(28680,'digit_count','if cur > digit:','if cur >= digit:','test_digit_reference_against_direct_decimal_strings')]:
 entry=next(e for e in json.loads((root/'collab/gmyhf-pending-batch13-review.json').read_text())['entries'] if e['global_number']==n)
 source=entry['authored_reference']['source'].split('import sys\nsys.stdout.write')[0]
 assert source.count(old)==1;ns={};exec(source.replace(old,new),ns)
 with patch.object(ReviewRulesTests,'reference',return_value=ns[fn]):
  result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(ReviewRulesTests(test));assert not result.wasSuccessful()
 results.append({'mutation':f'{n}参考代价或位数边界反转','detected':True,'failures':len(result.failures)})
s=Path(__file__).read_text()
(root/'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch9-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch':9,'results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(results),'种变异检出，源码已恢复')
